# Exiled Casual

> Exiled Casual is a free action role-playing game (ARPG) that runs entirely in a web
> browser, with nothing to install. It is inspired by Path of Exile 1 and 2, borrowing
> the best of each: Atlas map progression, procedurally generated areas, click-to-move
> combat, and deep itemization with prefix/suffix affixes, magic, rare and unique items.
> It is an original game, not affiliated with Grinding Gear Games or Path of Exile.

The game is playable at https://exiledcasual.com/ as an early development build. It changes
often and its balance is not final.

Key facts:
- Platform: any modern desktop web browser with WebGL2
- Price: free, no account needed for local play
- Saves: local, in the browser (IndexedDB); online accounts are planned
- Engine: TypeScript, React, Babylon.js, deterministic 30 Hz fixed-step simulation in a Web Worker
- Developer: IT-BAER
